title: Financially-distressed Consumers Seeking Debt Management Assistance and Respite Measures for Consumers and Businesses With Short-term Liquidity Issues
what_it_is: Financially-distressed Consumers Seeking Debt Management Assistance and Respite Measures for Consumers and Businesses With Short-term Liquidity Issues

sections.label: Household and corporate debt resilience
sections.summary: Fewer financially-distressed consumers sought bank assistance, and non-performing mortgage and corporate loan proportions stayed low.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The number of financially-distressed consumers who have sought assistance from banks is not high and has been decreasing over the past year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Broader indicators also suggest that the household and corporate debt situation in Singapore remains resilient on the whole.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The proportion of non-performing mortgages has remained low, at less than 1% last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The proportion of non-performing corporate loans has also remained low, at about 2.6%.

sections.label: MAS coordination on unsecured retail loans
sections.summary: MAS was asked about coordinating with other agencies on household exposure to retailer unsecured loans, and cites work with Credit Counselling Singapore and financial literacy efforts.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Can I ask if MAS coordinates with other agencies in the Government to look at the exposure of households to unsecured loans provided by retailers, or consumer retailers since this would be part of the broader landscape of exposure, especially with concerns about economic shocks coming from outside?

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We have worked with Credit Counselling Singapore and also gone upstream with regard to ensuring that consumers and borrowers have increased their financial literacy, in terms of new kinds of products that the Member has mentioned.
